facts.text: Audrey mentioned that the flowers are called Peruvian Lilies and have bright colors and delicate petals.

evidence.quote: They're called Peruvian Lilies. They are so awesome - they have such bright colors and delicate petals.

facts.text: Audrey stated that Peruvian Lilies are easy to care for, requiring only watering and sufficient sunlight.

evidence.quote: Nope, they're easy to take care of, perfect for me! Just gotta water them and make sure they get enough sun.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that the flowers are part of a garden that includes a veggie patch which is growing well.

evidence.quote: The flowers are looking great and my veggie patch is coming along.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that the dogs enjoy playing in the garden, running around and exploring.

evidence.quote: Yeah, they do enjoy the garden! Always running around, exploring and having a great time.
